sources.snippet: DarkIdol-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-1.2-Uncensored is an uncensored fine-tuned variant of Meta's Llama 3.1 8B Instruct model, developed by aifeifei798, that deliberately reduces safety alignments to enable open-ended text and code generation, particularly for roleplaying (including dark roleplay), writing prompts, quick responses, and scholarly outputs.
